**Feature ID:** `update-system-design-with-m0-decisions`.

**Owner:** `pipsystem` design and evidence workspace.

**Git author:** R. Andres Castaneda. **Original recorder:** UNKNOWN.

## Integration

Move the eight approved M0 outcomes into the target design so later work uses
agreed policy. Replace the rejected module-free and mandatory long-table
proposals without erasing their history or treating unresolved mechanisms as
decided. The October 7 integration also covered approved M1 R2, R3, and R4;
it did not settle M1 R1.

**Inputs:** The two October 7 M0 decision records, the confirmed M1 decisions,
and the separately approved exact design edits and charter sentence in the
integration plan and execution report.

**Outputs:** The integrated design and charter boundary, and a completed M0
roadmap feature linked to the integration plan. The eight decisions keep their
M0-01 to M0-08 numbers; the integration feature has no decision number.

## Check and gaps

**2026-11-25, pinned-record comparison: PASS.** Read the approvals, plan,
report, design, charter, and roadmap with `git show`. All eight numbered M0
matrix rows map to the integrated design. The approved replacements D1-D5 and
charter sentence match the pinned text. The roadmap preserves all nine M0 IDs,
marks this integration feature `done`, and links it to the October 7 plan.

**Runtime: NOT RUN.** Completion is for documentation. M1 R1 remains Open, as
do mechanisms for metadata versioning, persistent failure status, and dated
release capture and retrieval. This record does not establish package behavior.
